text:
Maya Patel: quick handoff from my shift — leaving at 09:00 PT. two things: current incidents and access checks.

Maya Patel: active incident: svc-search increased 5xx rate ~15m ago, linked in runbook. customer impact: search timeouts for ~0.8% of requests, mostly EU.

Maya Patel: primary = Jonas Lee (you're on pager through 17:00 PT), secondary = Sophia Chen. @jonas pls ack. @sophia you're backup and covering APAC overnight.

Jonas Lee: acked. noted EU skew. any ongoing mitigations?

Maya Patel: yes — temporary scale up executed (added two p4d nodes), traffic rerouted, but we still see KV cache misses. engineering is watching.

Maya Patel: access checklist before you take full ownership:
- PagerDuty: confirm you can see "prod-search-rotations" schedule and incident #PID-1123.
- AWS: assume-role into account `redwood-prod-123` as `OncallRole` (role ARN: `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/OncallRole`).
- Grafana: verify you can view org "prod-observability" and the "search-errors" dashboard.
- Runbooks: read-only links in the runbook doc, and make sure you can open the secure runbook in Confluence.

Jonas Lee: I can see PagerDuty schedule, confirmed. AWS role throws `AccessDenied` when I try to assume-role from my laptop.

Maya Patel: ok that's the gap. @Aisha can you help with cross-account role? might be a missing trust policy or SCP.

Aisha Khan: on it. quick check — Jonas has `redwood-dev` group, not `redwood-oncall`. I'll add the `OncallAssumeRole` group binding, then update the STS policy. will ping once done. ETA ~8m.

InfraBot: Deploy job #deploy-452 started by maya-p via CI (watching for infra changes).

Jonas Lee: thx. Grafana? I can view dashboards but not the alerting page to mute alerts.

Maya Patel: that's expected — muting requires `grafana-admin` role. if you need to mute during escalation, use the escalation play: notify infra and ask Aisha or me to mute. prefer to keep muting minimal.

Aisha Khan: updated IAM binding — Jonas should be able to assume now. Jonas, try again and send the exact command you ran if it fails: `aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/OncallRole --role-session-name jonas-oncall`

Jonas Lee: that worked, I have creds now. tested `aws s3 ls s3://redwood-prod-logs/search/ --profile oncall` and it succeeded.

Maya Patel: great. checklist complete?

Sophia Chen: quick question — my PagerDuty schedule shows a gap 23:00-00:30 PT. is that by design?

Maya Patel: hmm meant to be covered — ops rotation change wasn't synced. @Aisha can you add Sophia to the APAC overlap window or we'll swap shifts.

Aisha Khan: adding Sophia to the schedule now (prod-search-rotations). confirmation should appear in PD in ~2m.

PagerDuty Bot: Schedule update: user "Sophia Chen" added to "prod-search-rotations" for window 23:00-04:00 PT by Aisha Khan.

Maya Patel: runbook pointers for mitigation:
```
- runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/search-5xx
- playbook steps: check search-node memory, tail `search-api` logs, look for KV cache evictions
- temporary mitigations: scale + prefix cache warmup script: `scripts/warm-cache.sh --pattern=top-queries` (run from oncall jumpbox)
```

Maya Patel: escalation matrix: SEV1 -> page both primary+secondary + oncall-sre -> if >15m -> pager to infra lead (Aisha) -> exec notified.

Jonas Lee: noted. will monitor dashboards and metrics: `search_5xx_rate`, `search_latency_p50`, `kv_cache_miss_rate`. setting a 10m alert window.

Sophia Chen: got the PD notification. no more coverage gaps on my side.

Maya Patel: last thing — if you need to rotate to dedicated private infra, follow private-runbook step 4 (requires `OncallRole` and `vpn` access). confirm you can SSH to `oncall-jump.redwood.internal` (port 22).

Jonas Lee: ssh works.

Maya Patel: ok I'm signing off. leaving the thread pinned to the channel. back tomorrow; ping me if anything unusual. :wave:

Aisha Khan: thanks Maya — I'll monitor infra changes from here.

InfraBot: Incident watch: svc-search 5xx rate normalized to 0.9% over last 5m.

Jonas Lee: thanks everyone, taking over now.

Sophia Chen: thanks — I'll be reachable for APAC surge.
